Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Such offer(s) shall be summarily rejected. (c) Please submit following documents at the time of bidding, failing which the bid of the firm shall be s ummarily rejected i. Compliance statement ii. local content certificate iii. Non-disclosure certificate iv. Declaration certificate that firm not blacklisted for any Government department/PSU. v. Compliance of restrictions for countries which share land border with India. (d) VENDORS REGISTRATION:

i. Firms must be registered with Opto Electronics Factory or Sister Factories for same/ similar ite ms. Firms which are not registered for same/ similar item must submit duly filed Vendor Registration Req uest Form (VRRF) for tendered item at the time of bidding, failing which the bid of the firm shall be summ arily rejected. Vendor Registration Request Form (VRRF Form) is attached at the end of this document as annexure-z , which has to be used until online VRRF submission process is resumed on Vendor registratio n portal of IOL’s website. ii. If firms already registered with Opto Electronics Factory or other Sister Factories for Similar range of i tems, please submit Registration Certificate along with Bid. (e) Bidders must ensure to upload correct catalogue while participating in GeM bid. The GeM supply ord er is found to be placed for the catalogue uploaded by the bidders, but the evaluation of the bid is done for the item tendered by the buyer. (f) Buyer would not be responsible for any anomaly in GeM SO due to upload of wrong catalogue by the seller and the GeM SO must be considered as placed for the item as specified by the Buyer in that corresp onding schedule. (g) Additional term and conditions- Check list of documents to be submitted along with supplies: i) Invoi ce (ii) WC/GC iii) QCC (iv) MTC (if applicable). (h) NOTE: - EMD is applicable as per clause of 1.5 & 3.15 of T&C of TE. (i) Bidders may note that GeM is capturing IP addresses of Buyer & Bidder. Receiving bids having same/ common IP address with either bidder(s) or buyer shall be rejected. (j) Kindly comply all T&C of Tender ATC, further refer clause 3.8 of ATC for payment terms. (k) All other tender terms and conditions are as per OFBPM 2018. (l) Documents required bill processing: (i) Perfromance Security Deposit (PSD), if applicable.
